titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Zdrowie — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Health — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Zdrowie na ósmoklasistę: objawy, lekarz, zdrowy styl życia. Prostsze niż matura — pod gry LingoSpark.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Health module: symptoms, the doctor, healthy habits. Simpler than Matura — for LingoSpark games.

items.definitionEn: a pain in your head
items.example: I have a headache after too much time on the phone.

items.definitionEn: a pain in a tooth
items.example: A toothache can keep you awake at night.

items.definitionEn: a pain in your stomach
items.example: He had a stomachache after eating too much junk food.

items.definitionEn: pain in the throat, often with a cold
items.example: I have a sore throat and I cannot swallow easily.

items.definitionEn: when liquid comes from your nose because of a cold
items.example: A runny nose is annoying but usually not serious.

items.definitionEn: forcing air from your throat, often when you have a cold
items.example: A dry cough kept her awake all night.

items.definitionEn: how hot your body is; a high one means you are ill
items.example: If you have a high temperature, stay at home.

items.definitionEn: a serious illness with fever, aches and tiredness
items.example: He caught the flu in January and missed a week of school.

items.definitionEn: to become ill with a common cold
items.example: You can catch a cold if you sit in wet clothes.

items.definitionEn: to feel as if you might vomit
items.example: Some people feel sick on the bus.

items.definitionEn: feeling that you might fall, as if the room is spinning
items.example: She felt dizzy after standing up too quickly.

items.definitionEn: a dark mark on the skin after a hit
items.example: There is a large bruise on his knee after the fall.

items.definitionEn: an injury where the skin is broken by something sharp
items.example: He cut his finger while slicing bread.

items.definitionEn: a small sticky covering for a cut
items.example: Put a plaster on the cut.

items.definitionEn: a strip of cloth used to cover an injury
items.example: The nurse put a bandage around his hand.

items.definitionEn: a written order from a doctor for medicine
items.example: Take this prescription to the chemist.

items.definitionEn: a shop that sells medicine
items.example: The chemist is next to the supermarket.

items.definitionEn: a general doctor you visit first
items.example: Make an appointment with your GP if the pain continues.

items.definitionEn: an arranged time to see a doctor or dentist
items.example: I have a dentist appointment at three o'clock.

items.definitionEn: a person who looks after your teeth
items.example: You should visit the dentist twice a year.

items.definitionEn: habits that keep your body well, such as exercise and good food
items.example: A healthy lifestyle includes sleep, sport and fruit.

items.definitionEn: to become heavier
items.example: He put on weight after the summer holidays.

items.definitionEn: to become lighter
items.example: She wants to lose weight before the sports day.

items.definitionEn: becoming ill when you eat or touch something
items.example: He is allergic to peanuts, so check every label.

items.definitionEn: an injection that protects you from a disease
items.example: The vaccination against measles is given in childhood.

items.definitionEn: simple medical help given before a doctor arrives
items.example: Every teacher should know basic first aid.

items.definitionEn: a vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital
items.example: Someone called an ambulance after the accident.

items.definitionEn: a serious situation that needs help immediately
items.example: Call 112 in an emergency.

items.definitionEn: medicine that reduces pain
items.example: Do not take more than two painkillers at a time.

items.definitionEn: to get better after an illness
items.example: It took her a week to recover after the flu.

items.definitionEn: to become well again after an illness
items.example: It took him two weeks to get over the stomach bug.

items.definitionEn: a regular visit to a doctor when you are not ill
items.example: You should have a dental check-up twice a year.

items.definitionEn: to feel pain; to cause pain
items.example: Does your ankle hurt when you walk?

items.definitionEn: a bone that has cracked or snapped
items.example: He has a broken bone in his arm and cannot write.

items.definitionEn: to start recovering after being ill
items.example: Drink tea and rest and you will feel better tomorrow.

items.definitionEn: to visit a doctor because you are ill
items.example: If it does not stop, you should see a doctor.
